sentences.en: Please accept this gift for the celebration on your wedding.
sentences.zh: 请接受这份礼物作为你们婚礼庆祝活动的贺礼。

sentences.en: The women went to the celebration dressed to the nines.
sentences.zh: 那些女士们盛装出席了这场庆典。

sentences.en: All the parents were present at the kids' school celebration.
sentences.zh: 所有的家长都参加了孩子们学校的庆祝活动。
